candidates.change_summary: Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender, changing the withdrawal path and thus observable behavior.
Remove the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and thus changing observable behavior.
Replace transfer to send (using .send) which returns a bool and may fail silently, changing post-withdraw balance when transfer would have reverted.
Replace transfer with low-level call that does not revert on failure, allowing withdraw to appear successful while funds not sent (no require on result).
Remove the ownership check by replacing the modifier body to not revert, allowing non-owners to call withdraw and thus change observed withdraw behavior.
